mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 72 degrees with clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park. We have a waning gibbous moon, an overnight low of 52 degrees, and no rain expected. If you look toward the horizon at 8:38 PM, you can spot the International Space Station as it passes over Mount Horeb moving toward Belleville.

The Plan Commission will review several land use and site plans on October 5th, including projects on Country View Court and Spring Rose Road. Additionally, the city is actively working on the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to guide our city's future growth.

Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is trivia at Hop Haus Brewing and at Lake Lou-ee, plus plenty of music and markets coming to town through the end of the week.

Reviewing the weekly reports, on September 24th, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicyclist crash on Westward Drive involving an 11-year-old child, who was fortunately cleared by EMS without needing hospital transport.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10:00 PM, and today's flavor of the day is the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. It is a local favorite, so make sure to stop by before they close for the night.
